summary: Restore the cited preterit wording mxalxela ruḥa
rationale: 65/531 reads W mxalxela ruḥa li xaṣraṯe w laṯe. The entry adds ko- absent from that wording and omits ruḥa (herself). Restore the actual verb phrase while retaining the entry’s boundaries; it then agrees with the Preterit box and reflexive translation.
